question: When is the National Voters Day celebrated in India?
solution:
The correct answer is** __25th January.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Indian government has chosen to observe January 25 **as "National Voters' Day" annually in an effort to encourage more young people to participate in politics. To commemorate the** founding day of the Commission**, it was launched on January 25, 2011. On **National Voters Day, students demonstrate.**
 
• The** "My Vote is my Future- Power of One Vote"** National Voter Awareness Contest has been launched by **ECI. January 25, 2021,** was observed as the **country's 12th National Voters' Day**. Indian Vice President during the** national event in New Delhi.**
 
• Since 2011, **January 25 has been designated as National Voters Day** (NVD) to commemorate the founding day of the Election Commission of India (ECI), **which was created on this date in 1950. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The themes of** corruption, loyalty, guilt, authority, greed, and tradition **are explored in Chinua Achebe's novel The Voter.
 
• **Voting is a further duty of citizens**. Voting is not required by law, yet it is a crucial component of every **democracy.**
 
• By voting,** citizens are engaging in the democratic process.** Leaders are chosen by the people who will serve as their representatives and **champion their causes. **
